attributes.name: Blessing of the Inheritor
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to add 3 dice to any check against a bane that has the Demon trait.

During a character's turn, discard this card to allow that character to explore her location.

When you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Iomedae trait, shuffle that card into a random character's deck.

corrections.corrected_text: On the blessing Blessing of the Inheritor, change "If the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Iomedae trait" to "When you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Iomedae trait".
corrections.issue: When does the last part of Blessing of the Inheritor trigger?
